name: Xoi trung kien
summary: Xôi trứng kiến is sticky rice with brown-ant eggs. The 15 February 2023 culture page says Ninh Bình’s come from Nho Quan and the dish exists only in February. It says the eggs pop when chewed.
origin: Nho Quan, Ninh Bình. A 5 November 2024 tourism article also names xôi trứng kiến for Nho Quan.
howToEat: Eat the rice with fried shallot, which is what that culture page describes.
where: Nho Quan, in February on the 2023 page. A solar window inside February was not printed.
seoTitle: Xoi trung kien — ant-egg sticky rice
seoDescription: Nho Quan sticky rice with ant eggs, only in February on the 15 February 2023 culture page.
